text:
lena-sales: Quick sync — Marlin procurement asked for a short POC to validate thin-client throughput. Goal: 220 qps sustained, p99 < 300ms single-turn. Need runbook + hosted vs dedicated cost delta by EOD.
chao-eng: We can run a 10m smoke. Clarify model (quantized vs base), avg tokens, region, and whether to include cold-cache path.
marta-ml: They use very short prompts: ~20 tokens in, ~18 tokens out. Recommend redwood/v2-tiny-q4 for primary, and one comparison on v2-small-q4. Include cold-cache (kv disabled) and a short 60s microburst at 600 qps to see shedding.
lena-sales: Region eu-west-1. They asked about GDPR/data residency notes and audit log contents for the report.
ben-ops: Draft run plan: 1) warmup 90s @ 15 qps, 2) ramp 90s to 220 qps, 3) sustain 6m @ 220 qps, 4) 60s spike @ 600 qps, 5) cool down 2m. Capture p50/p95/p99, backend queueing, and batch-size histogram.
ben-ops: k6 command I'll use:
```bash
k6 run --vus 220 --duration 10m --out json=marlin_run.json k6_marlin_thin.js
```
chao-eng: Server config: 2xT4s, batching window 25ms, kv-cache enabled by default. max_batch_tokens 512. Expect p99 ~180-260ms on v2-tiny-q4 at 220 qps. v2-small will improve tail.
marta-ml: Also run one path with kv-cache disabled and max_output_tokens=96 to capture worst-case. We'll collect per-token breakdown (batching, kernel, io).
sam-se: Security blurb for sales deck: "Smoke runs mask PII; only metadata (request_id, model_version, timestamp, worker_region) are persisted in logs. For Private deployments we support KMS-backed key residency and audit export to customer SIEM as contractual options." Use that wording.
lena-sales: Cost ask: quick back-of-envelope for a 1-hour dedicated run (2xT4 reserved) vs hosted token burn for the same sustained traffic.
ben-ops: Quick math: 220 qps * 18 tokens * 3600s = 14.256M tokens/hr. Hosted token cost (quantized pricing approx $0.08/1M) -> ~ $1.14/hr in token charges (note: list). Dedicated infra (2xT4 amortized) ~ $9-12/hr; runtime+network overhead pushes to ~$14/hr. Microburst allowance may add a few dollars depending on burst policy.
chao-eng: I'll run tonight and attach traces + batch histograms. No HSM/SSO blockers for this quick smoke; enterprise SSO/HSM needs formal setup.
marta-ml: License check: open quantized variants are fine for POC. If Marlin asks for export controls or bilateral DPA clauses for embeddings we'll escalate legal.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: created loadtest job: job_id=lt-4210012345-1 status=queued
lena-sales: Great — please aim to post results by 19:00 CET. I'll tell Marlin we have a short run scheduled and will follow up with the security blurb and costs. :thumbsup:
